y_failures: Cites Arithmologia p.52 for the 'lemniscatus' (decorated with ribbons) etymology, but the page says nothing about it
reason: Y uses its sources well: Kircher pp.51–52 on ∞ as a Roman mark for 1,000, Atkinson p.28 on ∞ as Manifest Infinity and Waite p.297 on the Two of Pentacles, though it wrongly cites Kircher for the etymology. X links no specific pages, makes vague claims (Aeternitas in Prosopographia) and misses the key Kircher and Blavatsky lemniscate passages, so it is much less useful.
